entities.summary: Founded in 859 CE in Fez, Morocco, by Fatima al-Fihri, al-Qarawiyyin is recognized by UNESCO and Guinness as the oldest existing, continually operating educational institution in the world. It pioneered the concept of a degree-granting university and trained scholars in Islamic jurisprudence, grammar, astronomy, and mathematics for over a millennium.
